body.name: Iess
body.def: \(\mathcal I_T=\{\operatorname{dir}(i,j):i,j\in W,\ i\ne j\}\cup\{\operatorname{src}(C,j):\varnothing\ne C\subseteq W,\ j\in C\}\), with \(|\mathcal I_T|\le N(N-1)+N2^{N-1}\); source indices are their canonical child sets \(C\), so \(\mathcal I_T\) is invariant to source-value, source-order, and response-label permutations
